privacy_rules_text:
Last reforged: May 2026

1. Faal Vokul
You are a rah here, joor. No real names, no farspeaker ciphers, and absolutely no leaking your ex's dwelling. We want this void to be completely severed from your mortal theatrics.

If you accidentally slip up and reveal your true visage or doxx another, do not expect a warning. We will purge that Thu'um faster than you can blink, and your access might vanish with it. Keep it 100% unseen.

2. Do Not Be A Wretched Falmer
Ranting? Good. Crying? We hear you. Lamenting how much your labor sucks is exactly why we forged this Kel, so feel free to release your Su'um without holding back.

But throwing straight-up hate speech, targeted harassment, or bullying? No, that is a swift carriage to exile. There is a distinct boundary between venting your Krosis and just being a toxic troll.

3. No Hermaeus Mora Hoarding
We do not buy, sell, or even care about your private lore. What happens in Amomimus, stays in Amomimus. Your sessions are warded and will be wiped clean from our archives.

4. No Khajiit Caravans
This stage is for mortal passions, not for hawking your wares, boasting your bazaar, or bellowing merchant pacts. Selling here will get you exiled.

5. Winters Survived
Joore must be at least EIGHTEEN winters old to partake in this fellowship. The Thu'um here can be mature, heavy, and raw. Shield your mind.

6. Ownership of the Voice
You own the words you scribe, but by nailing them here, you grant Amomimus a shared privilege to display them namelessly across the realm.

7. The Guards' Watch
Even phantoms have borders. If you discover a Thu'um that breaks our laws, use the condemn tool. Our Golem sentinels watch day and night.

8. Dark Brotherhood Ban
Do not employ this scroll to scheme, muster, or incite any real-world bloodshed or ruin. We obey mortal laws and will strike down transgressions.

9. Scrying the Aether
We gather only nameless arcane dust like device shape and realm zul to make sure the scroll flows smoothly. None of it can be tracked to your true face.

10. Shiftings of the Rotmulaag
We hold the privilege to renew these decrees whenever the winds of magic shift. Continued use means you bow to the new rituals.
